notes: The N15 and H condensed mixture density uses ideal additive component volumes.
The p+N15 REACLIB rate has no declared validity interval and is a screening input above stellar temperatures.
The gray photon-trapping model uses only Klein-Nishina electron scattering at photon energy kT.
The carbon recoil cold stopping range is bounded above by the alpha range; hot-plasma stopping is not yet solved.
No N15 fuel is free: at most one terminal N15 burn is available per closed desired cycle unless extra carrier loops are charged.
